create_group_conversation: create a group conversation with multiple participants and an optional title using MessagingAppV2
send_message: send a direct message to a user which auto-creates a 1-on-1 conversation if needed
read_conversation: read messages from a conversation with pagination offset and date range filters
regex_search: search conversations by regex pattern across message content, titles, and participant IDs
list_recent_conversations: list the most recent conversations with configurable offset and message limits per conversation
